title: Figure 20: Comparison of Known and Unknown Object Sightings by Speed, 1947–1952
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing "Total Less Unknown" (left) and "Unknown" (right) object sightings, in percent, across speed categories: Stationary, Less than 100 mph, 100 to 400 mph, More than 400 mph, Meteor-like and Not stated. Both axes run from 0 to 40 percent. Caption: "FIGURE 20 COMPARISON OF KNOWN AND UNKNOWN OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY SPEED, 1947-1952"; drawing A-7498.
